content.text: Now let me test pipes, filter composition, and the flag:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/t_pipe.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
]
# entry "entry": params n:U8, s:Str ; result r:U8
# filter "f1": param q:U8, requires q < 10
# filter "f2": param t:Str, requires match(t, "[ab]*") -- has its own pipe to f3
# filter "f3": param u:U8, requires u != 0
modules = [
  {"name": "entry", "params": [["n", "U8"], ["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
  {"name": "f1", "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
   "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 10]]},
  {"name": "f2", "params": [["t", "Str"]], "result": ["o2", "U8"],
   "requires": ["match", ["var", "t"], "[ab]*"]},
  {"name": "f3", "params": [["u", "U8"]], "result": ["o3", "U8"],
   "requires": ["ne", ["var", "u"], ["const", "U8", 0]]},
]
pipes = [
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"q": "n"}},
  {"target": "entry", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"t": "s"}},
  {"target": "f2", "filter": "f3", "bind": {"u": "n"}},   # f2's own pipe, binds f3.u to entry.n
]
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": None, "runs": []}
got = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(got["plans"][0], indent=None))
# harness: n -> x0 (w1); s -> x1 buffer, x2..x5 chars; r -> x6; flag -> x7
assert got["plans"][0]["slots"] == [["x0", ["n"], 1], ["x2", ["s", 0], 1], ["x3", ["s", 1], 1],
                                     ["x4", ["s", 2], 1], ["x5", ["s", 3], 1], ["x6", ["r"], 1]]
assert got["plans"][0]["flag"] == "x7"
assert got["plans"][0]["variables"] == 8
# modules: entry depends on f1, f2; f2 depends on f3 -> eligible: f1, f3 -> lexicographic: f1, f3, f2, entry
assert got["plans"][0]["modules"] == ["f1", "f3", "f2", "entry"], got["plans"][0]["modules"]
print("PASS pipe plan")

def mk(n, s, r, flag):
    objs = [obj("x0", n, 1)]
    for i in range(4):
        objs.append(obj("x2" if False else "x%d" % (2 + i), ord(s[i]) if i < len(s) else 0, 1))
    objs.append(obj("x6", r, 1))
    objs.append(obj("x7", flag, 1))
    return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

# n=5 (<10 ok), s="ab" (matches), n!=0 ok -> all accept -> flag must be 0
doc["runs"] = [mk(5, "ab", 0, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0]["status"] == "READY", g["records"]
print("PASS accept with flag 0")

# flag mismatch: all accept but flag=1 -> INVALID_TEST
doc["runs"] = [mk(5, "ab", 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "INVALID_TEST"}, g["records"]
print("PASS flag mismatch (all accept, flag 1)")

# n=15 -> f1 rejects -> all-accept false -> flag must be 1 -> FILTERED
doc["runs"] = [mk(15, "ab", 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "FILTERED"}, g["records"]
print("PASS filtered by bound filter")

# n=15 but flag=0 -> mismatch -> INVALID
doc["runs"] = [mk(15, "ab", 0, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "INVALID_TEST"}, g["records"]
print("PASS flag mismatch on reject")

# s="ax" -> f2 rejects (match fails) -> flag 1 -> FILTERED
doc["runs"] = [mk(5, "ax", 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "FILTERED"}, g["records"]
print("PASS match filter")

# n=0 -> f3 (via f2) rejects -> flag 1 -> FILTERED
doc["runs"] = [mk(0, "ab", 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "FILTERED"}, g["records"]
print("PASS transitive filter rejection")

# entry's own requires false -> FILTERED (flag consistent)
modules[0]["requires"] = ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "U8", 5]]
doc["modules"] = modules
doc["runs"] = [mk(15, "ab", 0, 1)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "FILTERED"}, g["records"]
# n=5, entry requires true
doc["runs"] = [mk(5, "ab", 3, 0)]
g = run(doc)
assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": 3}, g["records"]
print("PASS entry predicate")
PYEOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/t_pipe.py
